%% Title Sample Submission Manuscript

# 1. Introduction

This is a sample submission manuscript used by the stage-matrix tests. It is a
*good* submission copy: relative CSL path, keywords as a style line, no
citations, no images — so it must pass every submission-stage check without
error. It extends `demo_project` so one fixture can be checked at the writing
stage (paper.md) and the submission stage (this manuscript) alike.
